name: rever-browser
tagline: AI agent browser for web reverse engineering
description: rever-browser is an Electron-based AI agent browser built for web reverse engineering. It wraps Chrome DevTools Protocol automation, deobfuscation tooling, API security inspection, and MCP support into a single agent-driven browser. Instead of juggling separate scraping, debugging, and proxy tools, security researchers get a browser that is designed to be driven by AI agents while doing the RE work directly.
highlights: Browser built specifically for web RE, not repurposed for it
Chrome DevTools Protocol automation under the hood
Deobfuscation, API security inspection, and MCP support
Early-stage but focused: 17 stars, 1 fork, Apache-2.0
curatorNote: A niche tool for a real workflow: agents doing web reverse engineering need a browser that exposes protocol-level control, not a general browsing UI. Early, but the design intent is right.
